messages.author: 389d046fc2d602cf
messages.subject: how to root beast object
parts:
Hi all,

I have a consensus tree from MrBayes. I was able to edit a lot of my tree after read.nexus()
But I noticed the posterior probabilities that are in the file were not imported with the rest. I changed to read.beast() and it definitely carried the rest of the info in the file, but now the function I was using before to root the tree doesn't work. I was using root().
How do you root your bayesian trees?
Can I convert an object type beast into some other format that will accept the root function?

The error is:

Error in UseMethod("root") : 
  no applicable method for 'root' applied to an object of class "beast"

Thanks!

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: how to root beast object
parts:
re-rooting the tree structure also need to map evolutionary statistics to the new tree structure and some of the statistics make not make evolutionary sense after re-rooting.

This is why root method for `beast` object is not implemented in `treeio` package.

Be careful if you want to this.
